query: I filed my GSTR-3B for October 2023 with a delay of 20 days. My tax liability was NIL. What is the late fee?
expected_logic: Since tax liability is NIL, late fee is Rs. 20 per day (Rs. 10 CGST + Rs. 10 SGST), subject to a maximum of Rs. 500.

query: I claimed excess ITC of Rs. 1 Lakh in Jan but reversed it in Feb without utilizing it. Do I need to pay interest under Section 50?
expected_logic: Interest under Section 50(3) is applicable only when ITC is availed AND utilized. Since it was not utilized, no interest is payable per Rule 88B.

query: My consignment value is Rs. 60,000 including exempt goods of Rs. 20,000. Is E-way bill mandatory for intra-state movement?
expected_logic: Consignment value for E-Way Bill excludes exempt goods. Taxable value = 60k - 20k = 40k. Since 40k < 50k threshold, E-Way Bill is NOT mandatory.

query: I am a service provider in Telangana with turnover of 18 Lakhs. Do I need to register?
expected_logic: Threshold for service providers in Telangana (Normal State) is Rs. 20 Lakhs. Since 18L < 20L, registration is not required.

query: I collected tax of Rs. 2 Lakhs but failed to pay it to the government for 4 months. What is the penalty under Section 122?
expected_logic: Penalty is strictly 100% of tax (Rs. 2 Lakhs) OR Rs. 10,000, whichever is higher. So penalty is Rs. 2 Lakhs.

query: Can I claim ITC on food and beverages provided to employees in the office canteen?
expected_logic: ITC on food and beverages is blocked under Section 17(5) unless it is obligatory under any law.

query: I received legal services from an advocate. Who is liable to pay GST under reverse charge?
expected_logic: GST on legal services by advocates is payable by the recipient (business entity) under reverse charge as per Section 9(3).

query: I received an advance of Rs. 5 Lakhs for supply of goods in March but supplied goods in April. When is time of supply?
expected_logic: For goods, time of supply is date of invoice or last date of issue of invoice as per Section 12. Advance receipt does not trigger time of supply for goods.

query: I am a manufacturer with turnover of Rs. 1.2 Crore. Can I opt for composition scheme and what will be my tax rate?
expected_logic: Composition scheme is available for manufacturers with turnover up to Rs. 1.5 Crore under Section 10. Rate is 1% (0.5% CGST + 0.5% SGST).

query: I am in Delhi and providing IT services to a client in Mumbai. What is the place of supply?
expected_logic: For B2B services, place of supply is the location of recipient (Mumbai). Since supplier is in Delhi and recipient in Mumbai, it is inter-state supply attracting IGST.

query: I exported goods with payment of IGST. How do I claim refund of IGST paid?
expected_logic: Refund of IGST on exports can be claimed under Section 54 by filing in GSTR-1/3B. Shipping bill is treated as refund application. Time limit is 2 years from relevant date.

query: The tax officer issued a show cause notice under Section 73 for short payment of tax. What is the time limit for adjudication?
expected_logic: Under Section 73 (non-fraud cases), the time limit for issuing order is 3 years from the due date of annual return.

query: I want to appeal against an order of adjudicating authority. What is the time limit and pre-deposit requirement?
expected_logic: Appeal to Appellate Authority under Section 107 must be filed within 3 months (extendable by 1 month). Pre-deposit of 10% of disputed tax is required.

query: Are educational services provided by a government-recognized school exempt from GST?
expected_logic: Services provided by educational institutions to students up to higher secondary level are exempt from GST.

query: A government department is making a payment of Rs. 3 Lakhs to a contractor. Is TDS under GST applicable?
expected_logic: TDS under Section 51 is applicable as payment exceeds Rs. 2.5 Lakhs. Rate is 2% (1% CGST + 1% SGST) for intra-state supply.

query: What is the due date for filing GSTR-9 annual return and is it mandatory for all taxpayers?
expected_logic: GSTR-9 is due on 31st December of next financial year under Section 44. It is mandatory for all regular taxpayers with turnover above Rs. 2 Crore.

query: I am providing services to a related person without consideration. How should the value be determined for GST?
expected_logic: Supply to related persons is taxable even without consideration (Schedule I). Value to be determined as per Rule 28 - open market value or comparable value.

query: I issued a credit note in November for a supply made in June of the same financial year. What is the last date to declare this credit note in returns?
expected_logic: Credit note must be declared in returns by 30th November of next financial year or date of filing annual return, whichever is earlier, as per Section 34.

query: I sent goods to a job worker 2 years ago. What is the time limit to receive back the goods?
expected_logic: Inputs must be returned within 1 year and capital goods within 3 years from the date of sending, as per Section 143.

query: What is the minimum number of digits of HSN code required on invoices for a business with turnover of Rs. 6 Crore?
expected_logic: For turnover above Rs. 5 Crore, 6-digit HSN code is mandatory on invoices as per the latest notification.

query: Can I claim ITC on a tax invoice dated April 2022 when filing my GSTR-3B for October 2023?
expected_logic: ITC on invoices for FY 2021-22 had to be availed by 30th November 2022 or date of filing GSTR-9 for FY 2021-22, whichever is earlier. The claim in October 2023 is time-barred under Section 16(4).

query: I sell a gift hamper containing chocolates, dry fruits, and a pen. How is GST rate determined?
expected_logic: A gift hamper with unrelated items at a single price is a mixed supply under Section 8. GST applies at the highest rate among all items in the hamper.

query: Can I claim ITC on purchase of a car for business purposes?
expected_logic: ITC on motor vehicles for transportation of persons (seating capacity up to 13) is blocked under Section 17(5)(a) unless the vehicle is used for specified purposes like transportation of goods, driving training, etc.

query: I imported goods worth USD 10,000. On what value is IGST calculated and who pays it?
expected_logic: IGST on imports is levied on the transaction value (CIF value + customs duty + other charges) under Section 5 of IGST Act. The importer pays IGST at the time of customs clearance and can later claim it as ITC.

query: I sell restaurant food through Swiggy. Who is liable to pay GST — me or Swiggy?
expected_logic: For restaurant services supplied through ECOs like Swiggy or Zomato, the ECO (Swiggy) is liable to pay GST under Section 9(5) instead of the actual restaurant supplier.

query: My head office in Delhi receives an invoice for a common service benefiting branches in Mumbai and Bangalore. How is ITC distributed?
expected_logic: Head office can register as Input Service Distributor (ISD) under Section 20. ITC is distributed to branches in proportion to their turnover in the period as per Rule 39.

query: I am a contractor building a commercial complex for a private client. What is the GST rate on works contract services?
expected_logic: Works contract services for construction of commercial buildings attract GST at 18% (9% CGST + 9% SGST). The rate differs for affordable housing and government works which attract 12% or lower.

query: I provide IT consulting services to a US company and receive payment in USD. Do I need to pay GST?
expected_logic: Export of services is zero-rated under Section 16 of IGST Act. You can export without payment of tax under LUT (Letter of Undertaking) and claim refund of unutilized ITC, or pay IGST and claim refund.

query: I manufacture textiles. My input GST rate (12%) is higher than output GST rate (5%). Can I claim refund of accumulated ITC?
expected_logic: Refund of accumulated ITC due to inverted duty structure is allowed under Section 54(3)(ii). The refund is calculated as per the formula in Rule 89(5) based on turnover of inverted rated supply.

query: The department alleges I have fraudulently claimed ITC. Under which section will the case proceed and what is the time limit?
expected_logic: Fraud cases are adjudicated under Section 74. Time limit for issuing SCN is 5 years from the due date of annual return. Penalty can be up to 100% of tax (plus mandatory penalty of 15% for appeal pre-deposit).

query: GST rate on my product was reduced from 18% to 12%. My customer claims I have not passed on the benefit. What law applies?
expected_logic: Section 171 requires suppliers to pass on the benefit of GST rate reductions or ITC increase to recipients through commensurate price reduction. Non-compliance leads to anti-profiteering proceedings.

query: I supply goods to a unit in a Special Economic Zone. What is the GST treatment?
expected_logic: Supply of goods or services to SEZ units or developers is zero-rated under Section 16 of the IGST Act. Supplier can either supply under LUT without payment of tax and claim ITC refund, or pay IGST and claim refund.

query: I made a mistake in the B2B invoice declared in GSTR-1 for April. Can I amend it and how?
expected_logic: B2B invoices in GSTR-1 can be amended in the amendment table of a subsequent period's GSTR-1 under Section 37. The amendment reflects in recipient's GSTR-2B for that period.

query: I am a Delhi trader participating in a 3-month exhibition in Goa. Do I need GST registration in Goa?
expected_logic: You must register as a Casual Taxable Person in Goa under Section 24 (mandatory registration regardless of turnover). Registration is valid up to 90 days under Section 27 and requires advance deposit of estimated tax.

query: I received road transport services from a Goods Transport Agency for moving my factory inputs. Who pays GST?
expected_logic: GST on GTA services (when GTA has not opted to pay GST forward charge) is payable under reverse charge by the recipient (your factory) under Section 9(3). Rate is 5% without ITC for GTA.

query: A private hospital charges for room rent, doctor fees, and medicines during inpatient treatment. Is GST applicable?
expected_logic: Healthcare services provided by a clinical establishment for diagnosis, treatment, or care are exempt from GST. This covers room rent, doctor fees, and medicines provided as part of inpatient treatment as a composite supply.

query: I run a standalone restaurant (not in a hotel above Rs. 7,500/night). What is my GST rate and can I claim ITC?
expected_logic: Standalone restaurants pay GST at 5% (2.5% CGST + 2.5% SGST) but are not entitled to claim ITC on inputs as a condition of the concessional rate.

query: My GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B have differences in output tax declared. What is GSTR-9C and who must file it?
expected_logic: GSTR-9C is a reconciliation statement between books of accounts and GST returns. It is mandatory for taxpayers with aggregate turnover above Rs. 5 Crore and must be certified by a CA or CMA under Section 44.

query: The GST officer detained my truck carrying goods without an e-way bill. What is the procedure and can I get the goods released?
expected_logic: Section 129 allows detention of goods and conveyance when transported without a valid e-way bill. Goods can be released upon payment of penalty (100% of tax for intentional default or 200% of tax for second offence) or on furnishing security.

query: My output tax liability is Rs. 10 Lakhs. Is there any restriction on paying the entire amount from ITC?
expected_logic: Rule 86B restricts registered persons with taxable turnover above Rs. 50 Lakh in a month from discharging more than 99% of tax liability from ITC. At least 1% must be paid in cash. This rule does not apply to certain categories including government entities.

query: I am a second-hand car dealer buying used cars from individuals and selling at a margin. How is GST calculated?
expected_logic: Second-hand goods dealers can opt for the margin scheme under Rule 32(5). GST is payable only on the margin (selling price minus purchase price). No GST if sold at or below purchase price. ITC not available on the purchased goods.

query: I want to export services without payment of IGST. What is a Letter of Undertaking and how do I file it?
expected_logic: Letter of Undertaking under Rule 96A is filed on the GST portal in Form RFD-11 by exporters who want to export goods/services without payment of integrated tax. It is valid for the financial year. The exporter undertakes to pay IGST with interest if the export conditions are not fulfilled.

query: I supply goods for Rs. 1 Lakh but separately charge Rs. 5,000 as freight and Rs. 2,000 as insurance. What is the value for GST?
expected_logic: Under Section 15, the value of supply includes all amounts charged by the supplier including freight, insurance, and other charges. GST is applicable on Rs. 1,07,000 (Rs. 1,00,000 + Rs. 5,000 + Rs. 2,000).

query: My employee provides services to me as part of their employment. Is this taxable under GST?
expected_logic: Services by an employee to the employer in the course of or in relation to employment are not treated as supply of services under Schedule III of CGST Act and are therefore outside the scope of GST.

query: My supplier has not filed GSTR-1. Can I still claim ITC on invoices received from that supplier?
expected_logic: ITC can be claimed only to the extent appearing in GSTR-2B as per Rule 36(4). If your supplier has not filed GSTR-1, the invoice will not appear in your GSTR-2B and ITC cannot be claimed until the supplier files and the invoice reflects in your GSTR-2B.

query: My GSTR-2B shows ITC of Rs. 80,000 but my purchase register shows Rs. 1,00,000. How much ITC can I claim in GSTR-3B?
expected_logic: As per Rule 36(4), ITC is restricted to the amount reflected in GSTR-2B (Rs. 80,000). The balance Rs. 20,000 can be claimed in the period when the supplier files their GSTR-1 and it reflects in your GSTR-2B.

query: The GST officer came to my premises and wants to inspect my records. Can they seize my documents?
expected_logic: Section 67 empowers the proper officer to inspect premises and seize goods, documents, and books of account if there is 'reason to believe' that tax has been suppressed or goods are liable to confiscation. Officer above Assistant Commissioner rank must authorize search.

query: What is the difference between a zero-rated supply and an exempt supply for ITC purposes?
expected_logic: Zero-rated supplies (exports, SEZ supplies) attract 0% tax but ITC on inputs is allowed and refundable. Exempt supplies attract 0% tax and ITC on inputs is NOT available and must be reversed under Section 17(2). This is a critical distinction.

query: I am renting out my commercial property to a registered GST dealer for Rs. 1 Lakh per month. Is GST applicable and who pays it?
expected_logic: Renting of commercial immovable property by a registered person to another registered person is taxable at 18%. If the landlord is unregistered, the tenant (registered person) pays GST under reverse charge as per Notification 13/2017 (Central Tax Rate).

query: I imported goods via CIF terms. Is IGST payable on ocean freight charges included in the CIF price?
expected_logic: After the Supreme Court's decision in Mohit Minerals (2022), IGST on ocean freight for CIF imports cannot be levied separately on the importer under reverse charge. IGST is already subsumed in the CIF value on which customs/IGST is paid. The earlier Notification 10/2017-IGST mandating RCM on ocean freight was struck down.
